"""Execute the fitted curved brush sweeps with the Panda and save a replayable trajectory."""
import json,math,time,os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
ROOT='/app/output'

def pressure(width):
 return float(np.interp(width*227.18/256,[0,6.65,7.1,9.76,11.31,11.75],[0,2,3,5,7,10]))

def execute(strokes, out='trajectory.npz'):
 s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');p=s.primitives();s.record_start();started=time.time()
 def move(pos,speed=.18,settle=3):return p['move_tip'](pos,speed=speed,settle=settle)
 def point(pt,z):
  x,y=s.geo.mm_to_world(*pt);return [float(x),float(y),z]
 for i,st in enumerate(strokes):
  x,y,a,l,b,w,col=st;dep=pressure(w);well=s.wells()[int(col)]['center_xy']
  cur=s.tip_pose()[0];move([cur[0],cur[1],.055],.13,2)
  move([*well,.055],.25,3);move([*well,.022],.10,3);move([*well,.055],.13,2)
  n=max(2,int(math.ceil(math.hypot(l,2*b)*227.18/256/1.5)))
  t=np.linspace(-.5,.5,n+1);u=l*t;v=b*(1-4*t*t)
  pts=np.stack([x+u*np.cos(a)-v*np.sin(a),y+u*np.sin(a)+v*np.cos(a)],1)*227.18/256
  # Keep contact points on the sheet, including the unscored margin.
  pts=np.clip(pts,1.0,226.1)
  move(point(pts[0],.045),.25,3)
  move(point(pts[0],.020-dep/1000),.06,4)
  # Interpolated Cartesian targets maintain a consistent sweep speed.
  for pt in pts[1:]:
   q,ok,err=s.ik(point(pt,.020-dep/1000))
   if not ok:raise RuntimeError(('IK failed',i,err))
   s.step(q)
  p['hold'](3)
  move(point(pts[-1],.045),.10,3)
  if i%25==0 or i==len(strokes)-1:
   print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,'seconds',round(time.time()-started,1),flush=True)
   Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(ROOT+'/canvas.png')
 acts=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(acts,ROOT+'/'+out)
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(ROOT+'/canvas.png');np.save(ROOT+'/ink.npy',s.ink())
 np.savez_compressed(ROOT+'/realized.npz',strokes=np.array(s.strokes(),dtype=object))
 print('SCORE',s.score(),flush=True);print('STATE',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
 return s
if __name__=='__main__':
 import sys
 strokes=json.load(open(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else ROOT+'/strokes.json'))
 execute(strokes)
